title: Partially close M9 Production qualification: reconcile offline criteria, flag production-infra criteria
objective: Honestly mark M9 as PARTIAL. Three criteria (C1, C4, C5) are satisfied by merged, CI-green code and are VERIFIED with durable evidence. Three criteria (C2, C3, C6) require REAL production infrastructure (live Postgres, an actual deployed release, and a recorded release/CI/deployment pipeline) that does not exist yet — mark these BLOCKED, NOT verified (no fabricated production-qualification evidence). This is the governed-consistent way to record 'engineering-complete, production-pending'.
forbidden_actions: commit directly to a protected baseline
mark C2/C3/C6 as VERIFIED (they require live production infra not present)
change a formal Foundry Program stage
authorize scientific, clinical, spending, outreach, transaction, or production action

acceptance_criteria.description: C1/C4/C5 recorded VERIFIED with durable evidence.
C2/C3/C6 recorded BLOCKED; M9 marked PARTIAL.
Contracts, secret scan, history-secret scan, schema drift, wheel, full test suite clean.

validation_commands: PYTHONPATH=src python3 scripts/export_schemas.py && git diff --exit-code -- schemas/
protected_actions: approve or merge the pull request
